name: Harmony Design System — Vanilla Web
description: Harmony Design System for frameworkless modern browsers — native HTML + CSS recipes, optional hybrid Custom Element helpers, and encapsulated Custom Elements. Dual consume: npm and static zip. WCAG 2.3 AA.

descriptions.native: Ship CSS (and docs) so the catalog item is real HTML and/or documented classes/tokens on the product stylesheet. Consumers compose children as they would in HTML — no Harmony-only wrappers or prescribed inner scaffolding. Foundation tokens use this strategy (CSS-only).
descriptions.hybrid: Same native CSS recipe is the source of truth; also ship an optional light-DOM Custom Element that maps attributes to those classes. Both paths remain complete and valid.
descriptions.web-component: Ship a Harmony Custom Element (typically open Shadow DOM, native ESM) when native HTML + classes cannot carry look, behavior, or a11y. Production data/events via attributes, properties, slots, and CustomEvent / ElementInternals — not a visual-only Astro port.
descriptions.skip: Do not convert; placeholder or accepted gap

readiness.summary: Playbooks complete for npm + static kit, product-once, WCAG 2.3 AA, production-gap HITL, AI artifacts. Element strategies: native | hybrid | web-component | skip. Demo bootstrap on :5178 proven (demo-bootstrap-1). Catalog execute awaits HITL plans.
